segments.ja459:1.3: Tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ, taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā;
segments.ja459:1.5: Mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ, tasmā pabbajito ahaṃ.
segments.ja459:2.1: Paradārañca disvāna, chando me udapajjatha [upapajjatha (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja459:2.3: Tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ, taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā;
segments.ja459:2.5: Mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ, tasmā pabbajito ahaṃ.
segments.ja459:3.1: Pitaraṃ me mahārāja, corā agaṇhu [agaṇhuṃ (sī. pī.), agaṇhi (ka.)] kānane;
segments.ja459:3.3: Tesāhaṃ pucchito jānaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākariṃ.
segments.ja459:4.1: Tena pacchā vijigucchiṃ, taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā;
segments.ja459:4.3: Mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ, tasmā pabbajito ahaṃ.
segments.ja459:6.2: Taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā, mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ;
segments.ja459:7.1: Surāmerayamādhukā [madhukā (sī. syā. pī.)], ye janā paṭhamāsu no;
segments.ja459:8.2: Taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā, mā puna akaraṃ pāpaṃ;
segments.ja459:9.3: Ye ahaṃ paṭisevanto, nālabhiṃ tādisaṃ sukhaṃ.
segments.ja459:10.1: Mahassādā sukhā kāmā, natthi kāmā paraṃ [kāmaparaṃ (sī. pī.)] sukhaṃ;
segments.ja459:10.3: Ye kāme paṭisevanti, saggaṃ te upapajjare.
segments.ja459:11.1: Appassādā dukhā kāmā, natthi kāmā paraṃ dukhaṃ;
segments.ja459:11.3: Ye kāme paṭisevanti, nirayaṃ te upapajjare.
segments.ja459:12.1: Asī yathā sunisito, nettiṃsova supāyiko [supāsito (ka. sī. niyya), supāyito (ka. aṭṭha.)];
segments.ja459:12.3: Sattīva urasi khittā, kāmā dukkhatarā tato.
segments.ja459:14.1: Visaṃ yathā halāhalaṃ, telaṃ pakkuthitaṃ [ukkaṭṭhitaṃ (sī. pī.), pakkuṭṭhitaṃ (syā.)] yathā;
